info.name: Word Count Guardrail - vendor-shaped rejection e2e
info.description:
End-to-end verification that word-count-guardrail renders its rejection in each LLM vendor's own convention (guardrailResponse, read live from the backing LlmProviderTemplate via policy.GetLazyResourceStoreInstance()) instead of the default WSO2 JSON shape.

Companion to gateway/dev-policies/word-count-guardrail/e2e/TESTING.md - read that doc for the full narrative; this collection is the same flows as importable requests.

Prerequisites:
1. Build the gateway with word-count-guardrail wired via gateway/build.yaml's filePath entry (see TESTING.md Part A).
2. Bring up gateway-controller + gateway-runtime (TESTING.md Part B).

No mock LLM backend is needed: every request-phase guardrail rejection here fires BEFORE the request would ever reach an upstream, so upstream.url is a placeholder and is never dialed.

Run folders in order: 00 (health) -> 01 (register) -> 02 (api keys) -> 03 (trigger + assert vendor shape) -> 04 (cleanup).

variable.description: gateway-controller REST management API, base path /api/management/v1

item.name: 00 - Health Checks
item.description: Confirm the gateway stack is up before registering anything.

request.description: Any response (even 401 without creds) proves the controller is up.

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: wcg-openai
spec:
  displayName: Word Count Guardrail Test (openai)
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /wcg-openai
  upstream:
    url: https://example.invalid
    auth:
      type: none
  policies:
    - name: api-key-auth
      version: v1
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            key: Authorization
            in: header
            valuePrefix: "Bearer "
    - name: word-count-guardrail
      version: v1
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            request:
              enabled: true
              min: 5
              max: 1000
              jsonPath: "$.messages[-1].content"
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]
